name: io.github.sapientsai/microsoft365-mcp-server
description: Microsoft 365 via Graph — mail, calendar, contacts, files, Teams, Planner, OneNote, To Do.

environmentVariables.name: MS365_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Azure AD application (client) ID — required in every auth mode

environmentVariables.name: MS365_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Azure AD tenant ID, or 'common'/'organizations'/'consumers'. Required for certificate and client-secret modes

environmentVariables.name: MS365_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Azure AD client secret (client-secret auth mode only)

environmentVariables.name: MS365_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Auth mode: interactive (default), certificate, client-secret, client-token, oauth-proxy

environmentVariables.name: MS365_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to expose read-only tools and refuse every write

environmentVariables.name: MS365_ENABLED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist of tool names to register; omit to register all

environmentVariables.name: MS365_PRESETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool presets to enable instead of naming tools individually
